subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Writing an ending; good and bad restaurants; analysing essay structure
outcomes: Write a suitable ending for a story
Sort phrases that describe good and bad restaurants
Recognise the parts of a narrative essay: topic sentences and supporting details

tf.s: 'Delicious food' and 'reasonable prices' describe a good restaurant.
tf.why: These are positive features of a restaurant.
Attentive service means waiters care about you, so it is good.

tf.s: 'Dirty cutlery' and 'rude waiters' describe a bad restaurant.
tf.why: Nobody wants dirty knives and forks or rude staff.

tf.s: The model essay has five paragraphs.
tf.why: It has an introduction, body paragraphs and a conclusion.

tf.s: A topic sentence is usually the last sentence of a paragraph.
tf.why: It is usually the first sentence and gives the main idea.

tf.s: Supporting details give more information about the topic sentence.
tf.why: They explain or give examples of the main idea.

tf.s: 'Errors on the bill' is a sign of a good restaurant.
tf.why: Mistakes on the bill are a sign of a bad restaurant.

tf.s: 'Cosy' describes a place that is warm and comfortable.
tf.why: A cosy restaurant feels friendly and relaxing.

tf.s: When you write an ending, you should copy sentences from the story.
tf.why: Use your own ideas to write the ending.

tf.s: 'Reasonable prices' means the prices are far too high.
tf.why: Reasonable prices are fair, not too expensive.

boxes.q: Which phrase describes a good restaurant?
boxes.why: A varied menu gives you many choices.

boxes.q: Which phrase describes a bad restaurant?
boxes.why: Mistakes on the bill annoy customers.
Cutlery is what you eat with.

o: The style and decoration of a place
boxes.why: Décor is how a place is decorated.

boxes.q: Where is the topic sentence usually found?
o: At the start of a paragraph

boxes.q: How many paragraphs are in the model essay?
boxes.why: The model essay has five paragraphs.

o: Our waiter was efficient and friendly.
boxes.why: It adds detail about the service.

boxes.q: Which word means 'fair, not too expensive'?
Which creature in a restaurant is a bad sign?
boxes.why: Cockroaches show the restaurant is dirty.

hunt.q: Decoration and style of a place

o: Usually the first sentence of a paragraph that gives the main idea
The last word of the essay
mcq.why: The topic sentence tells you what the paragraph is about.

mcq.q: Which list shows only good-restaurant phrases?
o: delicious food, varied menu, attentive service
rude waiters, dirty cutlery, large cockroaches
delicious food, rude waiters, errors on the bill

mcq.q: Which list shows only bad-restaurant phrases?
o: rude waiters, dirty cutlery, errors on the bill
reasonable prices, cosy décor, delicious food
attentive service, varied menu, rude waiters
delicious food, large cockroaches, cosy décor

mcq.q: What are the main parts of a narrative essay?
o: Only a title and a list
mcq.why: These parts give the essay a clear structure.

mcq.q: Choose the best supporting detail for the topic sentence 'The service was excellent.'
o: Our waiter was efficient, helpful and friendly.
mcq.why: This detail explains why the service was excellent.

mcq.q: Which is the best two-sentence ending for 'A Nightmare Meal'?
o: We never went back. From that day we always read reviews first.
Once upon a time there was a restaurant.
The restaurant opened in the morning.
First we looked at the menu.
mcq.why: It closes the story and shows a lesson learned.

mcq.q: You see a small restaurant with soft lights and comfortable chairs. Which word describes it?
mcq.why: Cosy means warm, comfortable and relaxing.

mcq.q: Why is the topic sentence usually placed first in a paragraph?
o: It tells the reader the main idea before the details
It is always the shortest sentence
It contains the ending of the story
Teachers never read the first sentence
mcq.why: Readers understand details better after knowing the main idea.

mcq.q: A paragraph says: 'The meal was terrible. The soup was cold, and the bread was hard.' Which part is the topic sentence?
mcq.why: The first sentence gives the main idea; the others support it.

mcq.q: Why would 'large cockroaches' make customers leave a restaurant?
o: They show the restaurant is dirty and unhealthy
They show the décor is cosy
They mean the service is attentive
mcq.why: Cleanliness is very important where food is served.
